elements.label: Table 20
elements.title: Table 20: Sustainability and Equity Impact of Various Cost-sharing Schemes
elements.content:
| Cost-sharing Modality | Financial Sustainability | Equity Impact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free higher education for all | Very costly | Richer students more likely to benefit |
| Universal fees | Less demanding on fiscal resources | Equitable if financial aid is available |
| Fees only for parallel students | Less demanding on fiscal resources | Richer students more likely to benefit |
| TFT | Costly | Potentially most equitable |

Source: Elaborated by the authors.
